answer: Bracket tournaments with entry fees: each epoch the beacon splits IDs into random brackets of 8, each paying a 1-token entry (proposed). Peers rank answers blind; only the top 2 per bracket split the pot, and answers that mirror a bracket-mate above 0.9 similarity share one placing. A farm of 100 clones pays 100 tokens but expects about 25 wins only if each answer is truly distinct, so cloning drives its return to a nadir while the fee river funds honest winners. Win rates unmeasured.
